-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This script looks at the overlap of unique species maps and argo floats cold spots
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
library(argoFloats)
library(oce)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tools)
library(sf)
library(terra)
```


```{r}
# Function to process overlap of argo cold spots and family maps
process_family_overlap <- function(fam_dir, coldspot_path, out_dir, expr_csv_path, proj_name) {

  cat("Starting Overlap Analysis for:", proj_name, "\n")
 
  
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  #  Get list of family map rasters
  fam_list <- list.files(fam_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(fam_list) == 0) stop("No family .tif files found in ", fam_dir)
  
  #  Load and align the coldspot raster to the family maps
  argo_coldspots <- rast(coldspot_path)
  ref_rast <- argo_coldspots

  
  #  Create area raster for coverage calculations of overlap
  area_rast <- cellSize(ref_rast, unit = "km")
  
 family_df <- data.frame(
    full_path = fam_list,
    base_name = basename(fam_list),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(family_expression = sub("\\.tif.*", '', base_name)) %>%
    mutate(family = sub("_.*","", family_expression)) %>%
   
    # Extract the analysis type from filename and reads the marine tag
    mutate(file_analysis = sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+).*", "\\1", family_expression)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  #  Load and format expression dataframe to marine analysis only
  expression_df <- read.csv(expr_csv_path) %>%
    select(-X) %>%
    filter(analysis == "marine") %>%
    group_by(family, analysis) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    distinct()
  
  #  inner_join on  family AND analysis
  fam_express_df <- inner_join(
    family_df, 
    expression_df, 
    by = c("family" = "family", "file_analysis" = "analysis")
  )
  
  #  Initialize coverage results dataframe
  coverage_results <- data.frame(
    family = character(),
    num_species = numeric(),
    coverage_area_km2 = numeric(),
    coldspot_area_km2 = numeric(),
    overlap_area_km2 = numeric(),
    overlap_percent = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop through each family map
  for (i in 1:nrow(fam_express_df)) {
    fam_file_path <- fam_express_df$full_path[i]
    print(fam_file_path)
    family_file <- fam_express_df$base_name[i]
    fam_avail <- fam_express_df$family_expression[i]
    num_species <- fam_express_df$count[i]
    
    if(is.na(num_species)) next 
    
    cat("Processing:", family_file, "(Species count:", num_species, ")\n")
    
    rast_layer <- rast(fam_file_path)
    print(crs(argo_coldspots))
     rast_layer <- project(rast_layer, crs(argo_coldspots))
    rast_layer <- resample(rast_layer, argo_coldspots, method = "near")

    # Calculate total family coverage area (where species exist)
    family_cells <- (!is.na(rast_layer) & rast_layer > 0)
    coverage_area_km2 <- global(area_rast * family_cells, sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    # Calculate total coldspot area
    coldspot_area_km2 <- 45470000 # this value is calculated from the previous RMD
    
    # Mask to coldspot area 
    overlap_rast <- rast_layer * argo_coldspots
    
    # Calculate overlap area (cells where family AND coldspot both exist)
    overlap_cells <- (!is.na(overlap_rast) & overlap_rast > 0)
    overlap_area_km2 <- global(area_rast * overlap_cells, sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    # Calculate what percent of coldspot is covered by this family
    overlap_percent <- (overlap_area_km2 / coldspot_area_km2) * 100
    
    # Add to coverage dataframe
    coverage_results <- rbind(coverage_results, data.frame(
      family = fam_avail,
      num_species = num_species,
      coverage_area_km2 = coverage_area_km2,
      coldspot_area_km2 = coldspot_area_km2,
      overlap_area_km2 = overlap_area_km2,
      overlap_percent = round(overlap_percent, 2)
    ))
    
   non_na_cells <- global(!is.na(overlap_rast), fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    if (!is.na(non_na_cells) && non_na_cells > 0) {
      
      max_value <- global(overlap_rast, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
      
      # FIX: Force min_value to 0 so 1-species pixels don't become 0 and get deleted!
      min_value <- 0 
      
      if (!is.na(max_value) && max_value > min_value) {
        overlap_rast <- (overlap_rast - min_value) / (max_value - min_value)
      }
      
      # Now, only true background 0s are deleted. Valid areas are kept!
      overlap_rast[overlap_rast == 0] <- NA
      
      out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(fam_avail, "_argo_overlap_", num_species, ".tif"))
      cat("Overlap:", round(overlap_percent, 1), "% of coldspots. Saving to:", out_path, "\n")
     # writeRaster(overlap_rast, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    } else {
      cat("  -> No overlap found. Skipping.\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Sort by overlap percentage and print summary
  coverage_results <- coverage_results %>% arrange(desc(overlap_percent))
  
  cat("\n Top 10 families in Argo Coldspot overlap \n")
  print(head(coverage_results, 10))
  
  # Save the coverage dataframe
  csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("coverage_results_", proj_name, "_touches1947.csv"))
  write.csv(coverage_results, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Coverage results saved to:", csv_path, "\n")
  
  cat("\nFinished processing", proj_name, "!\n")
  return(coverage_results)
}



# RUN FUNCTION FOR BOTH PROJECTIONS (for plots and accurate land measurements)


# expression dataframe
expr_csv <- "expression_df_2026_1957.csv"

# --- Run mollweide ---
coverage_moll <- process_family_overlap(
  fam_dir = "family_maps/mollweide",
  coldspot_path = "Argos/final_coldspot_raster_1resmoll.tif",
  out_dir = "Argos/argo_overlap/",
  expr_csv_path =  "expression_df_2026_1957.csv",
  proj_name = "Mollweide"
)

# --- RUN EPSG:4326  ---
coverage_4326 <- process_family_overlap(
  fam_dir = "family_maps/esri_4326",
  coldspot_path = "Argos/final_coldspot_raster_1res_4326.tif",
  out_dir = "Argos/argo_overlap/esri_4326_touches",
  expr_csv_path = "expression_df_2026_1957.csv",
  proj_name = "EPSG4326"
)


```
